questions: Margaritaville Vacation Club: margaritavillevacationclub.com redirects to mgvc.wyndhamdestinations.com, a Wyndham Destinations site. Keep that exact subdomain as a host, or treat the store differently?

Market Basket: marketbasket.com is The Market Basket, a New Jersey specialty market with gift baskets online, not the New England chain (shopmarketbasket.com) the supermarkets group may have meant. Keep it, swap the domain, or drop it?
max.com now redirects to hbomax.com after the service was renamed HBO Max. Keep max.com as the store domain with hbomax.com as a host, or re-key the store on hbomax.com?
McDonald's: mcdonalds.com has no checkout of its own seen; delivery checks out in Uber Eats or on mcdonalds.order.online (a DoorDash platform host). Keep it as a store?
MTA and OMNY: mta.info is the agency's information site (no checkout confirmed) and omny.info is its fare payment system. Keep both as separate stores, merge, or keep only omny.info?
Apple Music on music.apple.com shares apple.com with Apple's other stores, and its subscriptions are billed through Apple accounts. Keep it as its own store keyed on the exact subdomain?
pandora.com is the Pandora music streaming service (SiriusXM), not Pandora jewelry (pandora.net). Was the streaming service the intended store?
